updates.problem: RAKL lacks an executable typed relation/witness model that separates canonical same-object/equivalence GLUE from exploratory cross-domain JUMP while preserving broken correspondences, scope and evidence.
updates.target: Implement the smallest research-only witness object and relation catalogue against the frozen Round-011 benchmark before changing active atlas behavior.
blocking_requirements: preserved and not-preserved structure both recorded

updates.problem: A system can fail to retrieve a distant analogue, fail to recognize its structure after retrieval, or fail to transfer it correctly; current end-to-end analogy scores conflate these failure modes.
updates.target: Create a frozen corpus with known distant analogues and separately score candidate recall, witness construction and target transfer validity.

updates.problem: Domain stripping improves cross-domain recall but can remove material, scale, boundary, stochastic or intervention coordinates that invalidate transfer.
updates.target: Benchmark L0-L6 abstraction with explicit erasure ledgers and test whether critical-erasure detection reduces invalid transfers.

updates.problem: A scalar similarity or serendipity score can trade deep structural quality against remoteness using arbitrary weights and can reward irrelevant distance.
updates.target: Compare scalar ranking against constrained/Pareto selection over deep structure, domain distance, transfer utility, evidence readiness, analogy risk and cost.

updates.problem: Pairwise analogies can form misleading A-B-C paths when the shared B role, invariant, regime or approximation changes between hops.
updates.target: Define path certificates and hostile bridge worlds; BRIDGE_TO must remain navigation rather than automatic equivalence closure.

updates.consequence: RAKL must not claim analogy, remote structural retrieval, semantic-distance serendipity or graph discovery individually. Novelty review now targets witnessed GLUE/JUMP authority separation, erasure-aware transfer and evidence-governed analogy lifecycle.

relationship_to_prior_priority: META_N035 authority-poset remains open; N036-N040 extend the same no-escalation discipline to similarity and analogical transfer rather than replacing N035.
